about: Every source that a rule in practice/ cites. Tier 1 is peer-reviewed. Tier 2 is an extension service, a standard, a guideline or an established textbook. Sources in one group are not independent.

sources.citation: Texas A&M AgriLife Extension. DIY - Do It Yourself Backyard Mosquito Control.

sources.citation: Blaauw BR, Isaacs R. 2014. Larger patches of diverse floral resources increase insect pollinator density, diversity, and their pollination of native wildflowers. Basic and Applied Ecology 15(8):701-711.
sources.check_note: The publisher abstract is closed (Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex elide it, and ScienceDirect and ResearchGate were blocked). The same study's ESA 2013 abstract (esa.confex.com Paper78591) was read. It has plots of 1 to 100 m2 of 12 mixed species, and wild bees were higher in the 30 and 100 m2 patches. It gives no evidence about single-species clumps of about 3 ft.
